titolo: Il tavolo per Michele contro Tommaso (1)

mount.name: Carnosaur
mount.nota: La pelle squamosa vale armatura pesante (5+). Le Ferite Multiple (D3) degli artigli valgono solo contro i mostri, e la Blood Frenzy si accende quando il Carnosauro (non il cavaliere) ferisce: tutte e due a mano.

ruleText.Cold Blooded:
- **Restriction:** models with this rule (Lizardmen)
- **Timing:** whenever a Leadership Test or Break Test is required
- **Result:** you may add one D6 to the roll and drop the highest die
ruleText.Obsidian Blades:
- **Restriction:** 1 non-magical hand weapon carried by the model, never a mount's
- **Result:** the weapon has an Armour Piercing characteristic of -1
  - inactive whenever the model wields a pair of hand weapons or a weapon of another kind
ruleText.Rallying Cry:
- **Restriction:** character
- **Timing:** own Command sub-phase
- **Condition:** the character is not engaged in combat
- **Select:** 1× friendly unit that is fleeing, within Command range (optional)
- **Result:**
  - The unit takes a Rally test immediately
  - Test failed: normal rally attempt remains possible in the Rally sub-phase
ruleText.Predatory Fighter:
- **Restriction:** the model only, not its mount
- **Timing:** natural 6 on a To Hit roll in close combat
- **Result:** +1 Attack, with its To Hit and To Wound rolls made normally
  - such extra Attacks cannot themselves produce more
ruleText.Armoured Hide (2):
- **Restriction:** models with Armoured Hide
- **Result:** Armour Value improves by the number in brackets after Armoured Hide, for the model and its rider
  - No armour worn: counts as Armour Value 7+ when a rule improves Armour Value
ruleText.General:
- **Select:** every friendly unit inside the Command range of your General
- **Result:**
  - **Inspiring Presence:** a selected unit may use the Leadership characteristic of the General in place of its own.
  - Does not work while your General is fleeing, so rally the General before anything else.
ruleText.Blood Frenzy:
- **Restriction:** this model only, not its rider; Character Mount: a Carnosaur joins an army only as a character's mount, with its points counted toward the rider's total
- **Timing:** each time it inflicts an unsaved wound on an enemy model
- **Result:** it gains Frenzy, even if it lost Frenzy earlier in the battle
  - when Frenzied this way, the rider gets no +1 to its Attacks characteristic
ruleText.Close Order: Such a unit is able to form up in Close Order.
ruleText.Large Target:
- **Restriction:** Large Target (Large Targets)
- **Result:**
  - Partial and full cover give it no benefit
  - Line of sight to and from it passes across another unit, unless that unit is also a Large Target
  - Shooting unit gets 1 additional rank firing at it
ruleText.Stomp Attacks (2):
- **Restriction:** a model with Stomp Attacks (X); X is often a dice roll
- **Condition:** the attacker touches the enemy in base contact
- **Result:** **Resolving Stomp Attacks:** carried out after every other attack in combat, Initiative 1 ones included
  - They hit automatically.
  - They use the attacker's unmodified Strength.
ruleText.Swiftstride:
- **Restriction:** every model of the unit has Swiftstride
- **Result:**
  - Charge range ceiling: 3" higher.
  - Prior to a Charge, Flee or Pursuit roll, the unit may add +D6 to that roll (optional).
ruleText.Terror:
- **Restriction:** model with Terror
- **Result:** also causes Fear
  - When a Terror-causing unit declares a charge, its target takes a Leadership test straight away; failing means it must Flee, passing means it chooses its charge reaction as usual. A target that cannot choose to Flee skips this test.
  - When 1+ Terror-causing units are on the side that wins a combat: each unit on the losing side gets -1 to its Leadership characteristic for its Break test.
  - Causing Fear gives no protection against the Fear of Terror-causing models. Models causing Terror are immune to Terror; a unit not causing it gains no immunity when a character that does joins it.

mount.name: Ancient Stegadon
mount.nota: Con la regola Howdah conta come un carro (p. 13): le Ferite del personaggio si sommano alle sue. Il giant bow si può cambiare gratis con le giant blowpipes, o con l'Engine of the Gods (voce a parte).

ruleText.Arcane Vassal:
- **Limits:** 1× per turn
- **Condition:** this model is neither fleeing nor engaged in combat
- **Select:** 1 friendly Slann Mage-Priest ≤24" away may 'channel' one of its spells via this model (optional)
- **Result:** the spell is measured from this model, not from its caster
  - every effect, targeting restrictions, and its reach (the reach to dispel too, except for a vortex)
  - any line of sight it needs is drawn from this model
ruleText.Armoured Hide (1):
- **Restriction:** models with Armoured Hide
- **Result:** Armour Value improves by the number in brackets after Armoured Hide, for the model and its rider
  - No armour worn: counts as Armour Value 7+ when a rule improves Armour Value
ruleText.Aquatic (Rider only, not the mount):
- **Restriction:** models with this rule
- **Condition:** the players agree before the game which terrain counts as a 'Water feature' (shallow streams, fords, swamps, fast rivers, ponds, lakes)
- **Result:** such terrain counts as Open Ground for them
  - a unit with ≥50% of its models in a 'water feature' gains partial cover
ruleText.Cold Blooded:
- **Restriction:** models with this rule (Lizardmen)
- **Timing:** whenever a Leadership Test or Break Test is required
- **Result:** you may add one D6 to the roll and drop the highest die
ruleText.Lore Of Lustria v2:
- **Restriction:** Wizard with the 'Lore of Lustria v2' special rule
- **Select:** 1 of its randomly generated spells, discarded as normal (optional)
- **Result:** the Wizard picks a substitute among
  - Apotheosis v2
  - Monsoon v2
  - the signature spell of the Lore of Magic it chose
ruleText.Close Order: Such a unit is able to form up in Close Order.
ruleText.Great Horns: Each Impact Hits attack by this model resolves with Armour Piercing characteristic -3.
ruleText.Immune To Psychology:
- **Restriction:** unit with a majority of Immune to Psychology models
- **Result:**
  - Passes Fear, Panic and Terror tests automatically
  - Cannot choose Flee as a charge reaction
  - Leadership tests not named here are unaffected
ruleText.Impact Hits (D3+1):
- **Restriction:** charging model that moved 3"+, touching the enemy base
- **Result:** causes the number of Impact Hits given in brackets (often dice-determined)
  - **Resolving Impact Hits:** applied to the charged unit when its combat is picked, at Step 1.1 of the Choose Combat & Fight sub-phase, ahead of challenges
  - Automatic hits at the attacker's unmodified Strength
ruleText.Large Target:
- **Restriction:** Large Target (Large Targets)
- **Result:**
  - Partial and full cover give it no benefit
  - Line of sight to and from it passes across another unit, unless that unit is also a Large Target
  - Shooting unit gets 1 additional rank firing at it
ruleText.Poisoned Attacks (javelins only):
- **Restriction:** model with Poisoned Attacks
- **Condition:** natural 6 on a roll To Hit; does not work if a hit roll of 7+ is needed or the attack hits automatically
- **Result:** +2 on the roll To Wound for that hit (optional)
  - Valid in shooting and combat unless stated otherwise
  - Excluded: the model's own spells, attacks from magic weapons
ruleText.Stomp Attacks (D3+2):
- **Restriction:** a model with Stomp Attacks (X); X is often a dice roll
- **Condition:** the attacker touches the enemy in base contact
- **Result:** **Resolving Stomp Attacks:** carried out after every other attack in combat, Initiative 1 ones included
  - They hit automatically.
  - They use the attacker's unmodified Strength.
ruleText.Stubborn:
- **Limits:** only at this unit's first Break test of the battle; if not used then, it is lost
- **Timing:** this unit would make a Break test
- **Result:** skips it for an automatic Fall Back in Good Order (optional), even versus a winner with over double Unit Strength
  - Stubborn does not spread to non-Stubborn units from a joining character
  - Stubborn characters lose it inside non-Stubborn units
ruleText.Terror:
- **Restriction:** model with Terror
- **Result:** also causes Fear
  - When a Terror-causing unit declares a charge, its target takes a Leadership test straight away; failing means it must Flee, passing means it chooses its charge reaction as usual. A target that cannot choose to Flee skips this test.
  - When 1+ Terror-causing units are on the side that wins a combat: each unit on the losing side gets -1 to its Leadership characteristic for its Break test.
  - Causing Fear gives no protection against the Fear of Terror-causing models. Models causing Terror are immune to Terror; a unit not causing it gains no immunity when a character that does joins it.
ruleText.Howdah (Lizardmen):
- **Restriction:** behemoth with the Howdah special rule
- **Result:** the behemoth counts as a chariot mount, never a ridden monster (so a Stegadon or Ancient Stegadon is one)
  - its profile is split
  - it follows 'Split Profile (Chariots)' and 'Firing Platform'
ruleText.Arcane Configuration:
- **Restriction:** friendly model
- **Timing:** it casts a Bound spell
- **Condition:** an Engine of the Gods lies ≤12" from that caster
- **Result:** Casting roll improves by +1 (optional)
ruleText.Engine Of The Gods: The spell Burning Alignment is available to this model at Power Level 2.
ruleText.Portent of Warding: Spell Portent of Warding becomes castable by this model, at Power Level 2.

ruleText.Skirmishers: Such a unit is allowed to take up a Skirmish formation.
ruleText.Press of Battle:
- **Restriction:** Unit with this rule, arrayed in combat order
- **Condition:** It did not charge this turn
- **Result:** Its fighting rank counts as 2 ranks deep
  - Models directly behind, in base contact with a model of the actual fighting rank, also count as in the fighting rank
ruleText.Massed Infantry:
- **Restriction:** Side fielding at least one unit with this rule
- **Condition:** When combat results are tallied, that side's Unit Strength is the greater
- **Result:** It may claim +1 combat result point
ruleText.Parry:
- **Restriction:** Model with this rule, carrying a hand weapon plus shield
- **Condition:** In close combat, and opting to use that weapon and shield combination
- **Result:** armour value +1, capped at 3+

- **Restriction:** heavy infantry unit arrayed in Close Order or Open Order formation
- **Condition:** an enemy unit with a Unit Strength under 10 engages it in the flank or rear
- **Result:** it does not become Disrupted

ruleText.Choppas:
- **Restriction:** non-magical weapons only, never a mount; does not apply while the model uses a magic weapon
- **Timing:** turn of a charge by the model
- **Result:** the model gets:
  - To Wound rolls of natural 1: re-roll (optional)
  - Armour Piercing characteristic of its weapon(s): improved by 1 (e.g. - becomes -1)
ruleText.Furious Charge:
- **Condition:** made a charge move of 3"+ this turn
- **Result:** +1 Attacks characteristic
ruleText.Da Boyz:
- **Restriction:** army-list requirement, two-way pairing
- **Result:** the numbers of Black Orc Mob and Black Orc Boss must match
  - per Black Orc Mob: also 1 Black Orc War Boss or Big Boss
  - per Black Orc War Boss or Big Boss: also 1 Black Orc Mob
ruleText.Quell Impetuosity:
- **Restriction:** friendly Impetuous unit
- **Timing:** Leadership test deciding between a compulsory charge declaration and acting as normal
- **Select:** the unit, while ≤6" from a unit having this special rule
- **Result:** failed Leadership test: re-roll (optional)
ruleText.Ignore Panic:
- **Restriction:** unit
- **Timing:** ≤6" of this unit, a friendly unit lacking this rule is wiped out, or Breaks then flees; or such a unit flees through this unit
- **Result:** no Panic test is taken by this unit

- **Result:**

  - Test failed: normal rally attempt remains possible in the Rally sub-phase
ruleText.Waaagh!:
- **Restriction:** character; Orc unit = made only of Orcs or Black Orcs (mounted or not), and a Goblin character joining removes that status
- **Limits:** 1× per game; not cumulative
- **Timing:** your Command sub-phase
- **Select:** invoke the Waaagh! (optional): Leadership test with this character's own Leadership
- **Result:** if passed, the character, its mount and any Orc unit it has joined get:
  - To Hit rolls of natural 1: re-roll (optional)
  - combat result: +1 point (optional)
- **Duration:** to your next Start of Turn sub-phase
ruleText.Press of Battle:
- **Restriction:** Unit with this rule, arrayed in combat order
- **Condition:** It did not charge this turn
- **Result:** Its fighting rank counts as 2 ranks deep
  - Models directly behind, in base contact with a model of the actual fighting rank, also count as in the fighting rank
ruleText.Massed Infantry:
- **Restriction:** Side fielding at least one unit with this rule
- **Condition:** When combat results are tallied, that side's Unit Strength is the greater
- **Result:** It may claim +1 combat result point
ruleText.Parry:
- **Restriction:** Model with this rule, carrying a hand weapon plus shield
- **Condition:** In close combat, and opting to use that weapon and shield combination
- **Result:** armour value +1, capped at 3+
ruleText.Steady in the Ranks:
- **Restriction:** heavy infantry unit arrayed in Close Order or Open Order formation
- **Condition:** an enemy unit with a Unit Strength under 10 engages it in the flank or rear
- **Result:** it does not become Disrupted
ruleText.General:
- **Select:** every friendly unit inside the Command range of your General
- **Result:**
  - **Inspiring Presence:** a selected unit may use the Leadership characteristic of the General in place of its own.
  - Does not work while your General is fleeing, so rally the General before anything else.

ruleText.Fear of Elves:
- **Select:** every Elf, whatever its type
- **Result:** Fear is caused by them upon the model carrying this special rule
ruleText.Hatred (Dwarfs):
- **Timing:** first round of combat
- **Select:** failed rolls To Hit versus a hatred enemy
- **Result:** re-roll them (optional)
  - hated foes appear in brackets next to the name; 'all enemies' covers every enemy model
ruleText.Rallying Cry:
- **Restriction:** character
- **Timing:** own Command sub-phase
- **Condition:** the character is not engaged in combat
- **Select:** 1× friendly unit that is fleeing, within Command range (optional)
- **Result:**
  - The unit takes a Rally test immediately
  - Test failed: normal rally attempt remains possible in the Rally sub-phase
ruleText.Warband:
- **Condition:** the Warband is not fleeing
- **Result:**
  - Leadership characteristic +current Rank Bonus, capped at Leadership 10
  - The bonus is void for a Restraint test, and for an Impetuous unit's test on whether a charge is forced
  - Majority of models have Warband: re-roll its Charge roll (optional)
  - A character gets the bonus only if it too has Warband
  - A Warband unit takes the highest of: its own modified Leadership, a Warband character's modified Leadership, a non-Warband character's unmodified Leadership
ruleText.Clumsy:
- **Restriction:** unit with this rule
- **Result:** joining it requires Clumsy on the joining character as well; small characters fear getting trampled

Related: Monstrous Infantry
ruleText.Impact Hits (D3):
- **Restriction:** charging model that moved 3"+, touching the enemy base
- **Result:** causes the number of Impact Hits given in brackets (often dice-determined)
  - **Resolving Impact Hits:** applied to the charged unit when its combat is picked, at Step 1.1 of the Choose Combat & Fight sub-phase, ahead of challenges
  - Automatic hits at the attacker's unmodified Strength
ruleText.Loner:
- **Restriction:** Loner
- **Result:**
  - A character with Loner cannot be General; it joins only units with Loner
  - Units with Loner cannot be joined by characters lacking it
ruleText.Random Movement:
- **Condition:** the model has no normal Movement characteristic; a dice expression such as 2D6 replaces it
- **Result:**
  - Its moves happen in the Compulsory Moves sub-phase.
  - Each time the model moves, roll the dice: the total is its maximum distance.
  - No march and no charge declaration; wheel is the only manoeuvre allowed.
  - Reaching an enemy unit in Compulsory Moves or while pursuing is permitted (optional): it counts as having charged, aligns against that unit and halts. The unit hit this way must Hold.
  - Unit made only of Random Movement models: a single roll covers the unit.
  - Models in one unit with differing values: roll for each, the unit applies the lowest total.
ruleText.Armoured Hide (1):
- **Restriction:** models with Armoured Hide
- **Result:** Armour Value improves by the number in brackets after Armoured Hide, for the model and its rider
  - No armour worn: counts as Armour Value 7+ when a rule improves Armour Value

  - Flee roll: 2D6, keep the higher die (a tie: discard either)

ruleText.Release the Fanatics!:
- **Timing:** deployment; any Start of Turn sub-phase; Compulsory Moves sub-phase
- **Result:** Fanatics begin off the table
  - note each Night Goblin unit holding Fanatics and their number: ‘concealing’ units
  - a concealing unit neither fleeing nor in Marching Column may let go of 1+ Fanatics at any Start of Turn sub-phase (optional)
  - released Fanatic (it embarks on its erratic journey): positioned with its base ≤3" from the concealing unit, away from all other bases
  - **Fanatic Movement:** Compulsory Moves sub-phase of the release turn: 2D6" heading picked by its owner; all later ones: 2D6" in a random direction; contact with any friendly or enemy unit: it passes through, same heading, until its base is clear of other bases; the 1" rule is ignored
  - **Moving Through a Fanatic:** allowed for any unit; a unit stopping on top shoves the Fanatic by the shortest path until its base is clear of others
  - **Fanatic Ball & Chain:** each unit, friendly or hostile, crossed by a Fanatic or crossing one: D6 hits of Strength 5, AP -3
  - **Death of a Fanatic:** enemy units cannot charge it or engage it in combat; enemy shooting can target it as a lone character; templates hit it as normal
    - Fanatic into Fanatic: both are casualties
    - natural double on its movement, or contact with terrain that is difficult / dangerous / impassable, or a linear obstacle: casualty
    - concealing unit destroyed or fled off the battlefield before the release: they are casualties
ruleText.Fanatic Ball & Chain:
- **Timing:** a Fanatic moves through a unit, or a unit moves through a Fanatic
- **Select:** that unit, whether friendly or enemy
- **Result:** D6 hits
  - Strength 5
  - AP -3

ruleText.Da Boyz:

  - per Black Orc War Boss or Big Boss: also 1 Black Orc Mob
ruleText.Motley Crew:
- **Restriction:** Motley Crew units
- **Result:** may field one model type with varied gear, and/or several model types fighting as one unit; the army list entry may explain the make-up
  - **Different Weapons:** a fighting rank may hold varied weapons; roll a separate batch of dice for each differing model, tell the opponent which model it represents and the target; attacks follow each model's own Initiative
  - **Different Armour:** in combat, the armour value shared by most of the fighting rank counts; versus shooting, the armour value shared by most of the unit
  - **Casualty Removal:** versus shooting, spread casualties as evenly as possible across the differing models of the unit (by type or by gear); in combat, take them from the models forming the majority of the fighting rank; owner fills gaps with models from rear ranks

ruleText.Counter Charge:
- **Restriction:** a unit consisting only of models with Counter Charge
- **Timing:** an enemy unit of troop type 'cavalry', 'chariot' or 'monster' charges it into the front arc
- **Condition:** it is neither fleeing nor already engaged in combat
- **Result:** may declare the 'Counter Charge' charge reaction (optional)
  - Distance between units < Movement characteristic of the charger: too late, so it must Hold or Flee
  - Otherwise: pivot about its centre to face the charger's centre, then advance D3+1" straight at it; both units count as having charged this turn
  - 1× per turn however many chargers; after all charges are declared, the inactive player picks the charger to answer and Holds against the others
ruleText.Furious Charge (Orc Boar Boys & Boss Onl:
- **Condition:** made a charge move of 3"+ this turn
- **Result:** +1 Attacks characteristic
ruleText.Swiftstride:
- **Restriction:** every model of the unit has Swiftstride
- **Result:**
  - Charge range ceiling: 3" higher.
  - Prior to a Charge, Flee or Pursuit roll, the unit may add +D6 to that roll (optional).
ruleText.Tusker Charge:
- **Restriction:** War Boar's attacks only; no rider, chariot or crew
- **Timing:** any turn in which this War Boar made a charge
- **Result:** the War Boar's Tusks (hand weapon): Strength characteristic S+1, Armour Piercing characteristic -1
ruleText.Cavalry Support:
- **Condition:** a cavalry model can make a supporting attack
- **Result:** the rider alone attacks; the mount does not (a rider reaches over a comrade, a mount cannot)

Related: Light Cavalry

ruleText.Scythed Wheels:
- **Restriction:** heavy chariots
- **Result:** each of their Impact Hits has an Armour Piercing characteristic of -2
ruleText.Lumbering:
- **Restriction:** Lumbering models (heavy, with slow turning wheels or draft animals)
- **Result:**
  - the model is deemed a Close Order formation and follows its rules, even if it is a single model in your army
  - once it has moved, if it neither charged, marched nor fled, it may pivot on its centre, altering its facing by ≤90°
  - it may not join any unit, and no character may join it
  - Related: Heavy Chariots
ruleText.Iron Shod Wheels:
- **Restriction:** Chariots (this model)
- **Result:**
  - difficult terrain is handled as dangerous terrain
  - linear obstacles are handled as impassable terrain
  - Dangerous Terrain test result of 1: the model loses D3 Wounds
  - Related: Light Chariots
ruleText.Firing Platform:
- **Restriction:** this model
- **Result:** when it shoots or casts spells, its vision arc spans 360°

Related: Light Chariots
ruleText.Choppas:
- **Restriction:** non-magical weapons only, never a mount; does not apply while the model uses a magic weapon
- **Timing:** turn of a charge by the model
- **Result:** the model gets:
  - To Wound rolls of natural 1: re-roll (optional)
  - Armour Piercing characteristic of its weapon(s): improved by 1 (e.g. - becomes -1)
ruleText.Close Order: Such a unit is able to form up in Close Order.
ruleText.Impetuous:
- **Timing:** Declare Charges & Charge Reactions sub-phase of its turn
- **Condition:** the unit has 1+ Impetuous models and could declare a charge
- **Result:** the unit takes a Leadership test
  - Failed: it must declare a charge
  - Passed: it acts normally
ruleText.Ignore Goblin Panic:
- **Restriction:** unit; Goblin unit = made only of Goblins of every kind (mounted or not, plus war machine or chariot with all-Goblin crew); an Orc character joining removes that status
- **Timing:** a friendly Goblin unit ≤6" of this unit is wiped out, or Breaks then flees; or it flees through this unit
- **Result:** no Panic test is taken by this unit
ruleText.First Charge:
- **Restriction:** unit with First Charge
- **Limits:** 1× per battle, on its opening charge
- **Result:**
  - Disrupted: the charge target, expiring when the Combat phase of the same turn finishes
  - Only applies if the charging unit touches that target (checked once)
ruleText.Impact Hits (D6+1):
- **Restriction:** charging model that moved 3"+, touching the enemy base
- **Result:** causes the number of Impact Hits given in brackets (often dice-determined)
  - **Resolving Impact Hits:** applied to the charged unit when its combat is picked, at Step 1.1 of the Choose Combat & Fight sub-phase, ahead of challenges
  - Automatic hits at the attacker's unmodified Strength
ruleText.Tusker Charge:
- **Restriction:** War Boar's attacks only; no rider, chariot or crew
- **Timing:** any turn in which this War Boar made a charge
- **Result:** the War Boar's Tusks (hand weapon): Strength characteristic S+1, Armour Piercing characteristic -1
ruleText.Warband:
- **Condition:** the Warband is not fleeing
- **Result:**
  - Leadership characteristic +current Rank Bonus, capped at Leadership 10
  - The bonus is void for a Restraint test, and for an Impetuous unit's test on whether a charge is forced
  - Majority of models have Warband: re-roll its Charge roll (optional)
  - A character gets the bonus only if it too has Warband
  - A Warband unit takes the highest of: its own modified Leadership, a Warband character's modified Leadership, a non-Warband character's unmodified Leadership
